summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change switched payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable; orders were processed with no payment.
recommended: Verify payments-v2 reachability and readiness before retrying the migration
Add an alert on payment provider call failures, which are logged only at DEBUG

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Ops config change switched payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable; orders were processed with no payment.
evidence: config reloaded: payment_provider_url internal://payments-v1 -> internal://payments-v2 at 06:30:18
DEBUG payment: provider call failed: payment provider unreachable at internal://payments-v2
Alert: 10 of 27 orders processed with no payment; failures continued, reaching order 35
args.impact: Initially 10 of 27 orders had no payment (unpaid total_sar 6714.76 per the alert's money_impact). Failures continued as new orders arrived. Reprocessing paid 26 orders, money_recovered total_sar 16954.88. No integrity failures.
recommended_actions: Verify payments-v2 reachability and readiness before retrying the migration
Add an alert on payment provider call failures, which are logged only at DEBUG
args.summary: The ops config change to payments-v2 made the payment provider unreachable. The worker kept processing orders without recording payments. I reverted the URL to payments-v1 and reprocessed all unpaid orders. All invariants are now green.
